title: Smart Start
summary: YTIntel is now useful before you understand the product: paste a video, channel, competitor set or topic and it automatically chooses the right research workflow.
discord_changes: New Smart Start gives YTIntel one universal input and automatically routes videos, channels, competitor sets and topics into the right tool.
Deep Analyse now ends the single-video dead end with an immediate next-action layer that pushes promising ideas into cross-video validation.
Added recent-research resume, safer partial Pattern Mine setup and a simpler first-run experience while keeping the full Research OS underneath.
changes: Added Smart Start as the new front door to the Command Center.
A single YouTube video URL is detected and sent directly into Deep Analyse with the analysis started automatically.
A YouTube channel URL is detected and sent directly into channel-relative outlier discovery.
Five to ten YouTube URLs are detected and sent directly into Pattern Mine.
Two to four YouTube URLs are preserved in Pattern Mine and YTIntel explicitly tells the user how many more links are needed instead of returning a dead-end error.
More than ten links are safely reduced to the first ten for the current Pattern Mine limit and the user is told what happened.
Plain text is treated as a topic or niche and sent directly into Opportunity Radar.
Added live input classification so users can see where YTIntel will route the request before they run it.
Added a clipboard button with a graceful keyboard-paste fallback when browser clipboard permission is unavailable.
Added recent Smart Start history so recent videos, topics, channels and competitor sets can be resumed from the front door.
Added first-run example topics so a new user can see the workflow without already having a URL prepared.
Added a post-analysis next-action layer above the full evidence report.
Strong channel-relative candidates are explicitly labelled as promising but not proven, with one-click actions to Radar the topic or find similar videos.
Control-like or weak single-video signals are explicitly prevented from looking like validated opportunities.
Added a one-click quick brief export from a Deep Analyse result with the video, channel-relative performance, hook, takeaway, transferable mechanics and validation guardrail.
Added Smart Start to Quick Switch so keyboard users can jump back to the universal input immediately.
Kept the existing Discover → Investigate → Validate → Package → Learn workflow and all advanced Research OS tools intact.
Promoted v0.16.0 to the single shell owner so historical feature modules cannot downgrade the visible version, status or What's New experience.
Updated the service-worker cache to v0.16.0 and included the Smart Start runtime and styles in the offline shell.
Updated the installed-app identity and PWA shortcut wording around the simpler Smart Start entry point.
Included Smart Start recent-history data in full YTIntel backup/restore.
why_it_matters: YTIntel had accumulated strong research features, but feature depth was becoming a usability problem: a new creator had to understand the product architecture before knowing where to begin. Smart Start reverses that relationship. The user provides the thing they already have — a video, channel, competitor set or idea — and YTIntel chooses the workflow. The new post-analysis guidance also reduces one of the biggest research mistakes: treating one interesting upload as a repeatable market pattern. The goal is faster time-to-value without weakening the evidence guardrails that make the deeper product useful.
